+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: ffe480
+title: Three shipped swiftlint rules decline an item silently; adopt the stderr diagnostic marker
+---
+The stderr diagnostic carrier landed on `^m6ba1bf`. A tool-rule script now states a declined item with a stderr line opening `sah-diagnostic:` while exiting 0, and the report renders it. `builtin/validators/README.md` states the contract.
+
+Three shipped rules decline an item today and say nothing. Each has to write the marked line.
+
+## `missing-docs-swift`, `function-length-swift`, `magic-numbers-swift`
+
+Each holds this branch:
+
+```sh
+if [ "$measured" -eq 0 ]; then
+  if grep -qE '^Error: No lintable files found at paths:' "$work/lint.err"; then
+    exit 0
+  fi
+  exit 1
+fi
+```
+
+swiftlint judged NO file — the project `excluded:` list covers every file the run named — and the rule answers 0 findings at exit 0. That reads as a clean pass over files nothing linted. Write the marker before the `exit 0` and name the paths swiftlint refused.
+
+Each also holds a second one:
+
+```sh
+if [ -n "$project" ] && grep -qE '^Could not read configuration:' "$work/lint.err"; then
+  printf '%s\n' '<rule>: swiftlint cannot read .swiftlint.yml beside this rule. The run drops the project exclude list.' >&2
+  lint "" "$@"
+fi
+```
+
+That line is already a diagnostic on stderr at exit 0, and it is dropped. Give it the marker.
+
+## Done when
+
+- Each of the three rules writes a `sah-diagnostic:` line on both branches.
+- An acceptance test drives each shipped script over a project `.swiftlint.yml` that excludes every file and holds the run to reporting the diagnostic, not to silence.
+
+#tool-validators
\ No newline at end of file

     `complexity-swift` holds the same two branches and this card does not name it. Check that rule as well, or make a card for it.
   timestamp: 2026-08-17T07:02:19.000184+00:00
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m07cjtwk8bjr1cazdqsxt55j
+  text: |
+    Research, and the measurements that decided the shape.
+
+    `complexity-swift` does not exist. No rule file in `builtin/validators/` holds
+    that name, and a search for `Error: No lintable files found at paths:` finds
+    only the three rules this card names. So there is no fourth rule to change, and
+    no new card is necessary.
+
+    Measured with swiftlint 0.65.0, against the child configuration each of the
+    three rules writes:
+
+    - A SOUND run says nothing on stderr. Over one dirty file with no project
+      configuration: entries on stdout, and 0 bytes on stderr. That is what lets
+      the stderr channel carry a statement.
+    - The `Error: No lintable files found at paths:` line names EVERY path of the
+      run, and not only the paths swiftlint refused. Over `Sources/Absent.swift`
+      beside `Generated/Docs.swift` under `excluded: [Generated]`, swiftlint wrote
+      `Error: No lintable files found at paths: 'Sources/Absent.swift,
+      Generated/Docs.swift'`.
+
+    A forward of the whole stderr line under the marker was measured and it was NOT
+    taken. The reason is a DOUBLE statement, and the measurement shows it: for a run
+    over a path that holds no file and no other path beside it, the pre-flight
+    `[ ! -e "$file" ]` test already states that path, and the forward would state the
+    same path a second time. The shared helper `verify_declined_item_is_stated`
+    holds a run to ONE statement for one declined item, and the shipped test
+    `the_shipped_swift_function_length_tool_rule_declines_a_path_that_holds_no_file_alone`
+    reads exactly that run. So the branch states each path of the run that IS there,
+    one line for each, and the pre-flight test keeps the paths that hold no file.
+
+    Measured with the shipped script over each shape:
+
+    | the run | findings | diagnostics |
+    |---|---|---|
+    | one file under `Generated/` beside `excluded: [Generated]` | 0 | 1, that path |
+    | a directory that holds no Swift file | 0 | 1, that path |
+    | `src/Notes.txt`, whose name does not end in `.swift` | 0 | 1, that path |
+    | a path that holds no file, alone | 0 | 1, from the pre-flight test |
+    | a path that holds no file beside the excluded file | 0 | 2, one for each path |
+
+    No path goes unstated, and no path is stated twice.
+  timestamp: 2026-08-17T08:14:36.435429+00:00
